scope: Authenticated physical-node inspection through reserved host control admission and owned transport tasks. Separate namespace permissions, process/engine-bound request and response identity, bounded strict metadata, conservative sample ages and typed probe outcomes. Members and dormant sources/destinations use no invented member identities. Automatic reconciliation remains unimplemented.
environment: macOS native Node/SDK/RawNode/Raft Engine/SQLite/LTX/TLS with conditional in-memory object stores; four actual nodes, three voters and one dormant standby across two histories; real process refresh and command under retained metadata waiters. Held TCP/TLS endpoints and the real SDK admission seam exercise deterministic cancellation/revocation. No cellar_internal_tests.
limitations: Component qualification only. All 231 unique Rust cases across 11 binaries and all 19 checks pass at the pinned source. Ten new library cases and two new real-Node cases cover strict wire identity/progress, wrong-purpose/exporter/request MACs, cross-history and physical-owner bodies, independent/revocable namespace grants, stale process cancellation, held-socket lifetime, per-peer admission, original deadlines and failed-dial classification. The revocation case holds the host consumer seam after actual TLS/authentication and SDK admission; it does not claim a real SQL callback blocks inspection. The four-node fixture includes two registered histories, dormant endpoints and an actual committed command while 16 unpolled inspection waiters retain control capacity. It checks refreshed process identity with the same disk/engine instance. Five ignored child entry points execute through their owning parents and are excluded. All 42 snapshot, 19 membership, 27 host and 15 directory cases pass; public Node coverage remains its one affected Raft lifecycle case, with the prior 5751f36 record retaining all 88. Metadata has configured global 16-slot/16-MiB and two-slot-per-peer admission; held-socket tests directly exercise the per-peer bound, not a 16-physical-peer capacity qualification. Profile capacity is declared, not measured. Aggregate leader load remains absent until a complete bounded scan exists. The owned automatic controller, six-node no-business-traffic repair and automatic balancing remain required. The original MR-11 inventory is unchanged: five of seven names exist, with automatic_no_traffic_repair and leader_balance_with_lag absent. MR-12 through MR-17 remain TODO. Numeric markers remain 1. No physical S3, power-loss, real failure-zone, production performance/capacity, larger tier, federation or complete release qualification is claimed. Existing vendored warnings remain visible.
